request.prompt: Genuine hand-crafted 2D pixel art for a mature overhead exploration RPG. Visible square pixel clusters, controlled 24-color palette, dark 1-pixel style outlines, NO photoreal rendering, NO soft airbrush gradients. Orthographic camera angled down 55 degrees, no vanishing point, no isometric yaw. ONE isolated horizontally repeatable office wall segment, front-facing cross-section for overhead RPG. Wall assembly occupies a wide rectangle, 1200px wide by 280px high, centered. From top to bottom: solid charcoal wall TOP thickness band 70px deep, warm gray plaster INNER vertical face 180px high, narrow dark walnut skirting 30px high. All edges perfectly horizontal/vertical, equal widths top and bottom, no diagonal sides or converging edges. Top band clearly a thick wall cross section, flat dark fill with restrained pixel clusters; no extra bright rim. Understated Manhattan investment office, limited restrained color, readable chunky pixels. NO door, NO window, NO furniture, NO floor, NO end pillars, NO corner blocks. Uniform opaque saturated magenta #ff00ff outside wall silhouette. Seamless left/right ends for horizontal repetition.
